MTStringEventType.description: All data items with \gls{category} \uamodel{EVENT} where the data is       freeform text. The data type will be set to String for all the sub-types.       All extended type, regardless of controlled vocabularies, will use this       base type unless proprietary enumerations are added to the nodeset as       required by the builtin state event types inherited from       \mtmodel{MTControlledVocabEventType} (see       \ref{type:MTControlledVocabEventType}).
